requirements.quote:
An endpoint MUST ignore an ICMP message that claims the PMTU has
   decreased below QUIC's smallest allowed maximum datagram size.
requirements.condition: An ICMP message claims that the PMTU has decreased below QUIC's smallest allowed maximum datagram size.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint ignores the ICMP message.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The endpoint must not use the message to reduce the PMTU below QUIC's smallest allowed maximum datagram size.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can inject an ICMP message advertising a PMTU below the protocol minimum and verify that the endpoint ignores it.

requirements.quote:
QUIC endpoints using PMTUD SHOULD validate ICMP messages to protect
   from packet injection as specified in [RFC8201] and Section 5.2 of
   [RFC8085].  This validation SHOULD use the quoted packet supplied in
   the payload of an ICMP message to associate the message with a
   corresponding transport connection (see Section 4.6.1 of [DPLPMTUD]).
requirements.condition: A QUIC endpoint uses PMTUD and receives an ICMP message.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint validates the ICMP message to protect against packet injection.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests or static inspection can verify that a PMTUD implementation performs ICMP-message validation before acting on received messages.

requirements.quote:
[RFC8085].  This validation SHOULD use the quoted packet supplied in
   the payload of an ICMP message to associate the message with a
   corresponding transport connection (see Section 4.6.1 of [DPLPMTUD]).
requirements.condition: A QUIC endpoint validates an ICMP message.
requirements.required_behavior: The validation uses the packet quoted in the ICMP payload to associate the message with a corresponding transport connection.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can supply quoted packet data and verify that it is used to identify the affected transport connection.

requirements.quote:
ICMP message validation MUST include matching IP addresses and UDP
   ports [RFC8085] and, when possible, connection IDs to an active QUIC
   session.  The endpoint SHOULD ignore all ICMP messages that fail
   validation.
requirements.condition: A QUIC endpoint validates an ICMP message.
requirements.required_behavior: The validation matches the IP addresses in the ICMP quoted packet against the corresponding QUIC connection.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The endpoint must not treat validation as successful when the IP addresses do not match.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can vary quoted source or destination IP addresses and verify that mismatches cause validation failure.

requirements.quote:
ICMP message validation MUST include matching IP addresses and UDP
   ports [RFC8085] and, when possible, connection IDs to an active QUIC
   session.  The endpoint SHOULD ignore all ICMP messages that fail
   validation.
requirements.condition: A QUIC endpoint validates an ICMP message.
requirements.required_behavior: The validation matches the UDP ports in the ICMP quoted packet against the corresponding QUIC connection.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The endpoint must not treat validation as successful when the UDP ports do not match.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can vary quoted source or destination UDP ports and verify that mismatches cause validation failure.

requirements.quote:
ICMP message validation MUST include matching IP addresses and UDP
   ports [RFC8085] and, when possible, connection IDs to an active QUIC
   session.  The endpoint SHOULD ignore all ICMP messages that fail
   validation.
requirements.condition: An ICMP message contains a connection ID that can be checked against an active QUIC session.
requirements.required_behavior: ICMP validation matches the connection ID to an active QUIC session.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The endpoint must not treat the connection-ID check as successful when the connection ID does not match an active QUIC session.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can provide matching and nonmatching connection IDs when such IDs are available and observe the validation result.

requirements.quote:
ICMP message validation MUST include matching IP addresses and UDP
   ports [RFC8085] and, when possible, connection IDs to an active QUIC
   session.  The endpoint SHOULD ignore all ICMP messages that fail
   validation.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint ignores the ICMP message.
requirements.error_behavior: The failed-validation message is discarded without changing PMTUD state based on that message.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can inject an ICMP message with validation mismatches and verify that the endpoint does not act on it.

requirements.quote:
An endpoint MUST NOT increase the PMTU based on ICMP messages; see
   Item 6 in Section 3 of [DPLPMTUD].  Any reduction in QUIC's maximum
   datagram size in response to ICMP messages MAY be provisional until
   QUIC's loss detection algorithm determines that the quoted packet has
   actually been lost.
requirements.condition: An endpoint processes an ICMP message related to path MTU.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The endpoint must not increase the PMTU based on the ICMP message.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can deliver ICMP messages and verify that none causes an increase in the endpoint's PMTU state.

requirements.quote:
An endpoint MUST NOT increase the PMTU based on ICMP messages; see
   Item 6 in Section 3 of [DPLPMTUD].  Any reduction in QUIC's maximum
   datagram size in response to ICMP messages MAY be provisional until
   QUIC's loss detection algorithm determines that the quoted packet has
   actually been lost.
requirements.condition: An endpoint reduces QUIC's maximum datagram size in response to an ICMP message, and loss detection has not yet determined that the quoted packet was actually lost.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint may treat the reduction as provisional until loss detection determines that the quoted packet was actually lost.
requirements.why_checkable: State inspection can verify whether an ICMP-triggered reduction remains provisional pending confirmation of quoted-packet loss.
